findings.description: The title 'draws no question once a steer has answered it' claims more than the test checks: the fixture just leaves out `question`, and the steer event in `recentEvents` has no effect. Remove the steer and the test still passes. What it really pins is that the pane reads `session.question` and never rebuilds it from a `question` event, which is worth checking. The title should say that, e.g. 'draws no question the snapshot does not carry, even with a question event in history'.

The comment's last clause, "under its own heading above the gate", restates what the test title and the `indexOf` order assertion already say (AGENTS.md §Comments: never narrate WHAT). Ending the comment at "...the pane draws what it is handed." keeps only the WHY.

`frame.indexOf('question')` finds the heading only because nothing in the default fixture renders the word 'question' above it. If the header, goal or scope ever does, the order check silently tests the wrong text. Anchoring the order check to the heading regex from line 483 would be sturdier.
